model: Ideal event-level 164 + 688 + 273 logic truth-table model; not SPICE or physical test
checks: All 256 address bytes x 256 output bytes
Every non-selected board retains its previous byte
No output changes during shifting or STROBE low
Selected output commits only on LOW-to-HIGH STROBE end
Manual reset clears shift and output state
Sequential per-board writes retain independent values
limits: Does not simulate propagation glitches, supply integrity, loading or cable signal quality
Requires clean edges, initialized controller outputs and documented sequencing
